The '''mark 15''' [[Starship/Legends|starship]] diagnostic kit was produced by [[Quaxcon]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] stored one such kit aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="TG" />
